title: Kubernetes telemetry pipeline

expected_evidence_facts.fact: The orders-api workload exports OTLP over gRPC to the collector service in the observability namespace.
The collector accepts OTLP and sends metrics to its Prometheus endpoint, traces to Tempo, and logs to Loki.
Prometheus scrapes the collector metrics service endpoint every 30 seconds.
Grafana is provisioned with Prometheus, Tempo, and Loki data sources using their cluster-local services.
Grafana is exposed only by a ClusterIP Service in the supplied manifests.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: How should operators reach the ClusterIP-only Grafana service?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: Choosing internal-only access, an ingress, or another gateway changes the trust boundary and adds different access nodes and connections.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: What persistent storage and retention targets should Prometheus, Tempo, and Loki use?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: No persistent volumes or object stores are declared, and the decision can add three storage paths or managed backend boundaries.

forbidden_unsupported_assumptions: Do not invent an ingress, load balancer, SSO proxy, or external operator path.
Do not invent persistent volumes, object storage, retention periods, or managed telemetry services.
Do not replace the central collector with a node-level DaemonSet or sidecars.
Do not infer a cloud provider, cluster region, or cross-cluster telemetry path.
Do not execute kubectl, Helm, Kustomize, or any workload image.
